Atlas V Launch Services User Guide (ULA)

The reliable workhorse of United Launch Alliance, with over 100 successful launches since 2002. Carried Curiosity, Perseverance, MAVEN, MRO, New Horizons, and many of the most consequential US planetary missions of the 21st century.
First flyby of Pluto and its moons; sharpest images of a Kuiper belt world
USA-212 — 224 days on orbit, Vandenberg AFB
First nuclear-powered Mars rover; first sky-crane landing
First polar orbiter of Jupiter; solar-powered beyond the asteroid belt for the first time
USA-226 — 469 days on orbit, Vandenberg AFB
USA-240 — 675 days on orbit, Vandenberg AFB
First mission dedicated to studying how Mars lost its atmosphere
USA-261 / AFSPC-5 — 718 days on orbit, KSC Shuttle Landing Facility
Largest asteroid sample ever returned (121.6 g of Bennu, delivered to Earth 2023-09-24)
First to detect marsquakes; first interplanetary launch from US West Coast
First helicopter on another planet (Ingenuity); first sample caching on Mars
USA-299 / USSF-7 — 908 days on orbit, KSC Shuttle Landing Facility
First mission designed to image the Sun's polar regions in detail; complements Parker Solar Probe's in-corona measurements with high-latitude remote sensing
First mission to the Jupiter Trojans; visits 11 bodies across 8 asteroids and their satellites in a single 12-year trajectory — a record number of objects on separate solar orbits
USSF reusable robotic spaceplane — multi-year classified orbital missions, the only US spaceplane operational after the Shuttle's retirement
Atlas V's main pad — flew every Atlas V mission including Mars Perseverance + Lucy + Starliner CFT
Sample-returned Bennu (2023); now en route to Apophis
First detailed imaging of the Sun's polar regions
First mission to the Jupiter Trojans
Heavy lift for Artemis lunar program
1970s NASA outer-planet workhorse — Pioneer 10/11, Helios 1/2, Mariner 9/10, Pioneer Venus
Lifted Apollo 7, Skylab crews, and ASTP
Hydrogen upper stage, six decades and counting
Russian ox-rich staged combustion the US could not replicate
